name: Document - Document Stats Dashboard
description: Thống kê tài liệu: số lượng, trạng thái, thời gian xử lý

native.query: SELECT status, COUNT(*) as count FROM {{TENANT_SCHEMA}}.document_incoming GROUP BY status ORDER BY count DESC
SELECT 'incoming' as doc_type, COUNT(*) as count FROM {{TENANT_SCHEMA}}.document_incoming UNION ALL SELECT 'outgoing' as doc_type, COUNT(*) as count FROM {{TENANT_SCHEMA}}.document_outgoing
SELECT COUNT(*) as count FROM {{TENANT_SCHEMA}}.document_incoming WHERE created_at >= date_trunc('week', NOW())

cards.name: Văn bản đang xử lý (Top người phụ trách)

native.query: SELECT assignee_id as assigned_to, COUNT(*) as count FROM {{TENANT_SCHEMA}}.document_incoming WHERE status IN ('received','processing','in_progress','pending') AND assignee_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY assignee_id ORDER BY count DESC LIMIT 10
